podcast.body: Issued in early summer 1995 as a duet with her brother Michael Jackson, "Scream" served as the first single from Michael's "History" album. It debuted on the Hot 100 at number five, setting a new record for the chart's highest debut ever and surpassing The Beatles' 25-year-old record with "Let It Be." The high debut was partly attributed to the curiosity surrounding the pairing of the two siblings. "In the early summer of 1995, Michael Jackson issued screen, a duet with his sister Janet Jackson."
